title: AI Ghost plugin manifest
description: META-INF/plugin.yml (or plugin.yaml) of an AI Ghost plugin JAR.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier of the plugin.

description.description: Short description of what the plugin does.

icon.description: Base64-encoded plugin icon (SVG, PNG or JPG; the format is recognized from the decoded bytes).

providers.description: The plugin's contributions, grouped by kind. Today only 'ai' exists.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier of the provider, e.g. "openai".

implementation.description: Fully qualified class name of the AiProvider implementation.

name.description: Resource bundle key of the provider's display name.

contractVersion.description: Version of the AiProvider contract this implementation was built against.
